test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

They __praised__ her for her bravery.
solution:
The correct antonym is: **Rebuked.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**praised**" implies that they expressed approval or admiration for her bravery. (प्रशंसा)
 
• **"Rebuked" **means to express sharp disapproval or criticism of someone because of their behavior or actions, making it the opposite of praise. (झिड़की)
 
 
• An example of using** "rebuked"** correctly is, "The teacher rebuked the student for his constant tardiness to class."
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Acclaimed" **means praised enthusiastically and publicly, which is a synonym of **"praised." ** (प्रशंसित)

 
 
• **​****For example:** The artist was acclaimed for her innovative use of materials.
 
 
 
• **"Defended"** means to protect from harm or danger, which is **not** the opposite of praise. (बचाव किया)
 
 
• **​****For example:** In the debate, he defended his views passionately.
 
 
 
• **"Assaulted"** refers to making a physical attack, which is not an antonym in the context of verbal or written approval. (हमला किया)
 
 
• **​****For example:** The report showed that the victim was assaulted during the robbery.
